Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to identify the racetrack at the two-minute mark because it incorrectly assumed it could "watch" the YouTube video directly to extract visual information. In reality, standard web browsing tools cannot play video content or extract audio/visual data from it. This fundamental capability error prevented the agent from ever identifying the track name, causing the entire subsequent search for world records to be based on missing information.
